game.name: ReNFS5: Recomp Unleashed
game.desc: Experimental ARM64 static-recompilation port of Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed (2000, v3.2) for H700 handhelds. Supply your own game files as a folder, ZIP or CD image; the native launcher unpacks/verifies/imports them and provides a settings UI. OpenGL ES renderer via SDL2, SDL2 input/audio. On H700 races mostly run above 30 FPS.
game.developer: ReNFS5 port by rzrbld (original game: EA Canada / EA Seattle)
